script.cover_1: The manager says the work is not good. What to fix?
script.payoff: Without the exact miss, the junior has nothing to fix.
script.caption: Feedback without a target is only disappointment. Send this to the lead who expects better but never says where.
script.lands: The junior may replay it all day and still not know which part was wrong.
script.better: The second slide missed the client's ask. Fix it by 3 pm?
script.why: It names the exact miss and a time, so the junior knows what to change.
